_comment: Example Claude Code settings.json wiring plan-gate as a PreToolUse hook. Replace the absolute paths with your own. The env block turns the gate on and points it at your plans directory; the hooks block runs the gate before every gated tool call. PLAN_GATE_LOG_DIR is set, so a plan only takes effect after a human approves it in a terminal: python /home/you/strictlock/plan-gate/plan-gate.py approve /home/you/.agent/plans/<plan>.md (set PLAN_GATE_REQUIRE_APPROVAL=off to opt out). To honor scope-lease locks, also set PLAN_GATE_SCOPE_LEASE to the path of scope-lease.py.
